seriesName: CoreWeave on-demand GPU instance hourly prices, by GPU type
notes: All nine figures are read directly off CoreWeave's own public on-demand pricing page (coreweave.com/pricing), which is the same page already cited for the bullet's $49.24/hr HGX H100 rate. This gives the H100 rate context against CoreWeave's own other GPU tiers (older A100/L40 cheaper, newer Blackwell GB200/B200 pricier), rather than against AWS's $16.146/hr Capacity Block rate, because that AWS figure lives on a different site (fourweekmba.com) and rule 5 forbids mixing sites within one series. The page is a live, undated pricing page, not a dated news article, so there is no separate 'publication date' distinct from the access date; publishedAt above is the date this page was read (2026-10-05) and should be understood as 'current as of' rather than a fixed historical publish date. Two tiers shown on the page (GB300 NVL72, HGX B300, and RTX PRO 6000 Standard Memory) list 'Contact sales' instead of a number and were correctly left out per rule 1/9 (no invented figure). This series does not include the October 7 AWS reserved-capacity rate from the bullet; that number's only known home in our research was fourweekmba.com, a different site, so it could not be combined here without violating rule 5.
